summary: Internal web application called Report Request Portal for managing Power BI report requests. Standardizes and streamlines report requests to reduce duplication and improve clarity.
architectural_notes: Web-based internal application for report request management
Two simulated user roles: requester and admin
Status-based workflow: pending → approved/rejected → in development → completed

existing_features.title: Create a structured report request form with the following fields: Requester Name (text input), Department (text input), Business Objective (textarea), Required KPIs (textarea), Data Source (dropdown with options to be defined), Required Filters (textarea), Urgency Level (dropdown with options: Low, Medium, High), and Justification for New Report (textarea)
Add a mandatory checkbox confirmation on the report request form requiring users to confirm they have reviewed existing reports before submitting the request

Create a dashboard view for the BI team that displays a list of all submitted report requests with the following columns: Requester Name, Department, Business Objective (summary), Status (Pending, Approved, Rejected, In Development, Completed), Submission Date, and Assigned Reviewer
Implement a basic approval workflow allowing reviewers to approve or reject requests and add comments to each request
Create a clean, professional, and minimal UI design using a modern corporate style with simple navigation tabs for: Submit Requests, View Existing Requests, and Admin Dashboard
Implement simulated user roles (Requester and Admin) without authentication integration, where the application allows users to toggle between roles to access different features
Redesign the overall UI with improved visual hierarchy, spacing, and typography to create a more polished and modern appearance while maintaining the professional corporate style
Enhance the report request form (ReportRequestForm.tsx) with improved visual design including better field layouts, refined input styling, and clearer visual feedback for validation states
Improve the dashboard table design (RequestsDashboard.tsx) with enhanced visual styling including better row hover states, improved status badges, and clearer column headers
Enhance the navigation and header design (Layout.tsx) with improved tab styling, better role toggle presentation, and more polished overall layout
Refine the modal design (RequestDetailModal.tsx) with improved visual styling, better content organization, and enhanced interactive elements for the review workflow

Apply a cohesive visual theme across the application with a sophisticated color palette, refined use of shadows and elevation, and consistent interactive element styling to create a premium user experience
